hooks.name: Regenerate the accessibility feature list
hooks.description: When a kit, object or stage changes, rewrite docs/accessibility-report-*.md and docs/proof-report-*.md from what the kit actually guarantees. The list is never written by hand.

action.command: npm run report --workspace apps/ghastly-moves --workspace apps/seance-escape && npm run proof-report --workspace apps/ghastly-moves --workspace apps/seance-escape
